CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 09 / 12

Production and cost curves

Efficient scale有效率規模

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify efficient scale as the output minimizing ATC; calculate it from a cost schedule or graph.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

有效率規模是 ATC 最低的產量，可由圖最低點或表格比較找出。它與最大產量及 AVC 最低點不同。

Efficient scale is the output minimizing ATC. Read the lowest ATC point or compare ATC across a schedule. It is distinct from maximum output and from the minimum AVC shutdown threshold.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：ATC at Q=1,2,3,4 is 12,8,7,8. Efficient scale is Q=3. 第三單位產量平均成本最低。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

ATC values at Q=2,3,4 are 9,6,7. Efficient scale among these choices? 有效率規模？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
